# Bundled browser libraries

These files are bundled locally because Manifest V3 extensions cannot execute remotely hosted code.

- `marked.min.js`: Marked 12.0.2
- `purify.min.js`: DOMPurify 3.1.6
- `highlight.min.js`: highlight.js browser build 11.9.0

Upstream licenses are stored in `vendor/licenses/`.
